zh-CN.title: 回声唱片铺的店内陈列
items: 活动详情换上唱机主视觉、票根式积分进度和四款歌手封套。
奖池的气泡预览和专辑列表也统一为唱片铺的风格。

en.title: Inside the Echo Record Shop
items: The activity drawer now opens on a turntable scene, with a points ticket and four artist sleeves.
The rewards sheet brings bubble previews and the album catalog into the same visual style.
